limitations: The finite grid matrix is not the continuum differential operator.
The discrepancy combines finite-box boundary and spatial-discretization effects unless one control is held fixed.
The retained dimension changes the comparison space and is not an error bar.
The result is illustrative numerical verification, not semiconductor evidence or scientific validation.
